title: Portrait and Confession
author: Yara Pemberton
blurb: Edmund Vasquez, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
